text.en:
A new Section Six is hereby inserted after Section Five of Presidential Decree No. 778 which
shall read as follows:
"SECTION 6. The Secretary of Finance shall issue the rules and regulations for the proper and effective
implementation of this Decree."
Section Six of the same Decree is hereby renumbered as Section Seven.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
